found.truth_sql: SELECT sumOrNull(o.quantity) AS c0 FROM shop.orders o LEFT JOIN shop.users u ON o.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN shop.products p ON o.product_id = p.id WHERE (NOT ((o.product_id >= 31) OR (toFloat64(o.amount) < 11))) AND (toDate(toTimeZone(o.created_at, 'Asia/Kathmandu')) >= toDate('2025-04-01') AND toDate(toTimeZone(o.created_at, 'Asia/Kathmandu')) <= toDate('2025-11-02')) SETTINGS join_use_nulls = 1
